title: GRAND FINAL 🏆 Japan vs UK vs Vietnam… Which Country Wins Season 1? Marble Race
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 1 GRAND FINAL: the last 32 countries of the world in one marble race, 7 stages, only one champion.

The 32 finalists: Australia, Botswana, Burkina Faso, Costa Rica, Denmark, El Salvador, Ireland, Japan, Kenya, Kuwait, Kyrgyzstan, Latvia, Lebanon, Libya, Malaysia, Marshall Islands, Mongolia, Namibia, Nicaragua, North Macedonia, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Saudi Arabia, Somalia, Thailand, Tonga, Uganda, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, Vietnam, Yemen, Zimbabwe.

Countries still in the game before this race: 32 of 193.
Next race: Season 2 · Round 1 · Heat 1/7.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. New races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
